name: dosebloom
description: DOSEBLOOM — Smart Medicine Reminder & Daily Dose Tracker. A modern, colorful, animated, secure MERN application.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client

author: DOSEBLOOM Team
